description: A client that drops a stored Responses stream at its first text delta stops generation, and the next request is served.
notes: The donor swaps in a new engine with the script "Ready" before the last request; a script list expresses the same order. The fifth event is the first response.output_text.delta (created, in_progress, output_item.added, content_part.added, delta). The donor's lookup of the dropped response by id (404) needs a value captured from the stream, which the format does not express; it is left to the test that re-expresses this method.
